sourceTitle: Desi Chinese Schezwan Paneer Tikka Recipe
sourceText:
Desi Chinese Schezwan Paneer Tikka Recipe
By: ravikumar
Published: Friday, March 30, 2018 - 1:30am

Ingredients




6 tbsp Ching's Schezwan Chutney
300 gms Paneer Cubes
2 Cubed Onions
1 Cubed Capsicum
Lemon juice
Salt to taste

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Mix all ingredients (except lemon juice) together in a bowl 3 Step 2: 4 Skewer paneer and veggies alternatively. 5 Step 3: 6 Grill on a non-stick pan for 6-8 minutes or until browned 7 Step 4: 8 Drizzle lemon juice and serve hot with Schezwan chutney.

About

Schezwan Paneer Tikka Recipe gets better and tastier with Chings Schezwan Chutney. Paneer Tikka is the favourite recipe of all vegetarian food lovers has got a fresh twist which will make you hooked on to this dish even more. Desi Chinese Schezwan Paneer Tikka Recipe Easy to make, it can be served on all occasions.
